'''Jason Winter Jason's Palace Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jason Winter]]
* '''Published:''' July 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Holotable]]
* '''Strategy:''' Jason's Palace Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Jason's Palace Deck Winter DS 1997.txt |Download]]
